per_site.known_technique: cookie priming: GET www.bseindia.com first to collect session cookies, then call api.bseindia.com/BseIndiaAPI/api/ListofScripData/w with full browser header set (Origin/Referer/Accept). Our code already defines COOKIE_PRIME_URL but never wires it - that is the missing piece. If 403 persists, escalate to curl_cffi impersonate=chrome

per_site.verdict: revive adapter with cookie priming + curl_cffi fallback

prior_art.blocking_handling: browser-identical handshakes; Chrome/Safari/Firefox profiles; proxy rotation

framework_recommendation.architecture: keep the existing Adapter protocol (name + fetch(isin) -> FetchResult). Add a transport layer with pluggable transports per site class: TransportPlain (stdlib/httpx) for NSDL+agencies, TransportImpersonate (curl_cffi) for RBI/BSE/NSE, TransportBrowser (playwright) as last resort. Wire cookie priming into a shared SessionManager: warm-up URL -> cookies -> target call, per adapter.
framework_recommendation.discipline: cache-first (snapshot -> DB cache -> network; already implemented), 1 request/s per source (throttle exists), exponential backoff on 5xx/timeout only, identified User-Agent, respect robots.txt, fixture-based parse tests against schema drift (pattern already in tests/bond_master/fixtures), per-source health events (already implemented)
framework_recommendation.failure_handling: per-source isolation - one site's break never blocks others (SOURCE_PRIORITY loop already isolates); FAILURE codes already distinguish blocked vs unreachable after fix
